concept: Degree of democracy (continuous or many-point scale)
how_to_choose: Prefer V-Dem when you need long coverage, separate democratic dimensions and measurement uncertainty; use Polity5 only for replication or pre-1900 comparison and note that it ends in 2018; use Freedom House when rights performance rather than institutions is the concept; UDS and SVMDI summarise several sources but are frozen; treat EIU, BTI and GSoD as assessments with shorter series and check their source overlap with V-Dem before using them as independent robustness checks.
